subcategory_text: Roles and responsibilities for the workforce are established with respect to privacy.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-2 (Information Security Program Leadership), PS-7 (External Personnel Security)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.2 (Information security roles and responsibilities)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.RR-02 (roles and responsibilities defined)
implementation_examples: Document the workforce roles and responsibilities for privacy (e.g., data owner, privacy engineer, DPO, business unit accountable executive)
Embed role assignments in the HR system and include privacy responsibilities in role descriptions
Review and re-assign on organisational change
assessment_objectives: Determine whether privacy roles and responsibilities for the workforce are documented
Determine whether responsibilities are integrated into role descriptions and onboarding
Determine whether assignments are tracked in HR/IT systems
Determine whether role coverage gaps are detected and remediated
